profile_text.body:
Krisp is a Voice AI platform that provides audio processing tools for individuals, teams, and contact centers. The company describes itself as offering noise cancellation, transcription, meeting summaries, and accent conversion, all built on a shared AI voice engine. Its products are offered separately and installed individually rather than as a single bundled suite.

Krisp's main offerings include an AI Meeting Assistant, which provides bot-free transcription and note-taking across platforms such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Slack Huddles; a Call Center AI product aimed at contact centers, incorporating Accent Conversion, Voice Translation, Noise Cancellation, and Agent Assist features; and an AI Voice SDK that lets developers embed Krisp's audio capabilities directly into their own applications. The site identifies the platform as the number one noise cancellation solution, though noise cancellation is presented as one component of a broader set of voice AI capabilities rather than the sole focus.

The held facts confirm Krisp maintains a tracked product entry under the Voice and Audio category, listed at krisp.ai. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records appear in the available data.
